title: General Moelner: the secret craft filled a reconnaissance gap until spy satellites took over
summary: Nick Cook tells of General Moelner: the secret craft filled a reconnaissance gap until spy satellites took over, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: General Moelner's advice at face value, uh this thing just filled a gap. And when it had done its job of filling the gap, they went back to spy satellites.

plain: Nick Cook, a writer interviewed on Jesse Michels' podcast about secret flying craft, passes on what he was told by a man he calls General Moelner. According to Cook, the general said a secret American craft was built to fill a gap in spying from the air, and once it had done that job, the military went back to using spy satellites. Taken at face value, it would mean an advanced secret aircraft was used and then quietly set aside.
